run_lint_session: run the nox lint session to check flake8, black, and isort on mtrl, tests, and main.py
run_mypy_session: run the nox mypy session to perform static type checking on mtrl, tests, and main.py
run_yamllint_session: run the nox yamllint session to validate YAML config files in the config directory
run_setup_function: run the setup function to install setuptools, pip, and nox requirements in a nox session
review_lint_session: review the nox lint session configuration to understand which code paths are checked by flake8, black, and isort
